blocks.plain_text: Managing a proportional basis of selection for a standing offer

heading_path: Buyer's Guide Manage a contract - Standing offers and supply arrangements
Managing a proportional basis of selection for a standing offer
blocks.markdown: When a proportional basis of selection is used to select the contractor among multiple standing offers, you must ensure that identified users are aware of their obligation to follow the predetermined work distributions specified in the standing offers.
blocks.plain_text: When a proportional basis of selection is used to select the contractor among multiple standing offers, you must ensure that identified users are aware of their obligation to follow the predetermined work distributions specified in the standing offers.

heading_path: Buyer's Guide Manage a contract - Standing offers and supply arrangements
Managing a proportional basis of selection for a standing offer
blocks.markdown: The offeror whose actual work received is furthest below the predetermined ideal percentage detailed in the standing offer will be selected for the next call-up. A spreadsheet may be used to track all call-ups and to maintain a cumulative total for each offeror.
blocks.plain_text: The offeror whose actual work received is furthest below the predetermined ideal percentage detailed in the standing offer will be selected for the next call-up. A spreadsheet may be used to track all call-ups and to maintain a cumulative total for each offeror.

heading_path: Buyer's Guide Manage a contract - Standing offers and supply arrangements
blocks.markdown: ### Offerors' reporting obligations
blocks.plain_text: Offerors' reporting obligations

heading_path: Buyer's Guide Manage a contract - Standing offers and supply arrangements
blocks.markdown: You must ensure that offerors submit reports as required in the standing offer or supply arrangement. Typically, offerors must report on a quarterly basis on their call-up or contract activities.
blocks.plain_text: You must ensure that offerors submit reports as required in the standing offer or supply arrangement. Typically, offerors must report on a quarterly basis on their call-up or contract activities.

heading_path: Buyer's Guide Manage a contract - Standing offers and supply arrangements
blocks.markdown: These reports may include, but are not limited to:
blocks.plain_text: These reports may include, but are not limited to:

heading_path: Buyer's Guide Manage a contract - Standing offers and supply arrangements
blocks.markdown:
- standing offer or supply arrangement number
- business name
- reporting period
- each call-up or contract number, including any amendments
- client department
- contracting authority
- date of call-up or contract
- period of call-up or contract
- line items acquired or services provided
- total value of each call-up or contract, including applicable taxes
